```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(knitr)

# Reuses qc_germline_gene() so the filtering logic here can never drift out
# of sync with what actually ran -- this report is a view onto the same
# step1/step2/step3 objects, not a re-implementation.
source(params$qc_script)

# Pulled straight from qc_germline_gene()'s own default argument, not
# hardcoded here, so this can't drift out of sync if that default changes.
exclude_consequence_used <- eval(formals(qc_germline_gene)$exclude_consequence)

data <- read.csv(params$input_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

res <- qc_germline_gene(
  data, params$gene, dataset_label = params$gene,
  af_lower = params$af_lower, af_upper = params$af_upper,
  min_depth = params$min_depth, min_altdepth = params$min_altdepth,
  log_dir = params$log_dir
)
```

## `r params$gene`

QC report for germline carriers of **`r params$gene`**, built from variant calls in PMBB Release 4.0's GoldiLocks (GL)-filtered germline exome data.

**Input:** `r params$input_csv`

**Total variant-call rows:** `r format(nrow(data), big.mark = ",")`

**FILTER == PASS:** `r format(sum(data$FILTER == "PASS", na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")` (`r round(100 * mean(data$FILTER == "PASS", na.rm = TRUE), 1)`%)

## Filtering pipeline

Three stages are applied in order; each keeps only rows that passed the previous stage.

1.  **Gene + PASS + protein-coding.** Restrict to `r params$gene`, drop any row not marked `FILTER == PASS` at the site level, keep only `protein_coding` biotype, and drop rows with an uncalled ("." / -1 placeholder) VAF, depth, or alt-depth.
2.  **Genotype quality (Depth / VAF).** Keep calls with VAF between **`r params$af_lower`** and **`r params$af_upper`** (a heterozygous band), total depth \>= **`r params$min_depth`**, and alt-allele depth \>= **`r params$min_altdepth`**.
3.  **Consequence + LoF level.** Drop consequence categories considered unlikely to be disease-relevant (full list below), and keep only **Variant.LoF_level 1 or 2** (Brad's higher-confidence loss-of-function tiers).

```{r exclude-consequence-list, results='asis'}
cat(
  "**Excluded consequence categories** (matched as substrings against `Variant.Consequence`): ",
  paste0("`", exclude_consequence_used, "`", collapse = ", "),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Metrics per step

### Baseline metrics 

```{r step-metrics}
step_metrics <- tibble::tibble(
  Step = c("1: Gene + PASS + Protein-Coding", "2: Depth / VAF", "3: Consequence + LoF Level"),
  Variants = c(nrow(res$step1), nrow(res$step2), nrow(res$step3)),
  Individuals = c(
    n_distinct(res$step1$Sample.ID),
    n_distinct(res$step2$Sample.ID),
    n_distinct(res$step3$Sample.ID)
  ),
  `Removed (variants)` = c(NA, nrow(res$step1) - nrow(res$step2), nrow(res$step2) - nrow(res$step3))
)
kable(step_metrics, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

### Quality metrics 

Median (range) of each metric at each stage, excluding uncalled (-1) placeholders.

```{r quality-metrics}
qm_stage <- function(df, label) {
  vaf <- df$Sample.AltFrac[df$Sample.AltFrac != -1]
  dp  <- df$Sample.Depth[df$Sample.Depth != -1]
  ad  <- df$Sample.AltDepth[df$Sample.AltDepth != -1]
  rng <- function(x, d) if (length(x)) sprintf("%.*f (%.*f-%.*f)", d, median(x), d, min(x), d, max(x)) else "-"
  tibble::tibble(
    Step = label,
    VAF = rng(vaf, 3),
    `Total Depth` = rng(dp, 1),
    `Alt Depth` = rng(ad, 1)
  )
}

kable(bind_rows(
  qm_stage(res$step1, "1: Gene + PASS + Protein-Coding"),
  qm_stage(res$step2, "2: Depth / VAF"),
  qm_stage(res$step3, "3: Consequence + LoF Level")
))
```

### Loss of function (LoF) level per step

```{r lof-funnel}
lof_stage <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    mutate(LoF_Level = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Variant.LoF_level))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(LoF_Level)) %>%
    count(LoF_Level, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(Stage = label, .before = 1)
}

stage_levels <- c("Raw", "Step 1", "Step 2", "Step 3")

lof_long <- bind_rows(
  lof_stage(data, "Raw"),
  lof_stage(res$step1, "Step 1"),
  lof_stage(res$step2, "Step 2"),
  lof_stage(res$step3, "Step 3")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Stage = factor(Stage, levels = stage_levels),
    LoF_Level = factor(LoF_Level, levels = sort(unique(LoF_Level)))
  )

lof_table <- lof_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = LoF_Level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0, names_prefix = "LoF ") %>%
  arrange(Stage)

kable(lof_table, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## Variant landscape

```{r landscape-helpers}
variant_type_combined <- function(before, after) {
  fmt <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      count(Variant.Class, name = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Percent = 100 * Count / sum(Count))
  }
  before_tab <- fmt(before) %>% rename(Before_Count = Count, Before_Pct = Percent)
  after_tab  <- fmt(after)  %>% rename(After_Count = Count, After_Pct = Percent)

  full_join(before_tab, after_tab, by = "Variant.Class") %>%
    mutate(across(c(Before_Count, Before_Pct, After_Count, After_Pct), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    arrange(desc(Before_Count)) %>%
    transmute(
      `Variant Class` = Variant.Class,
      Before = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", format(Before_Count, big.mark = ","), Before_Pct),
      After = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", format(After_Count, big.mark = ","), After_Pct)
    )
}

consequence_combined <- function(before, after) {
  fmt <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      count(Variant.Consequence, name = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Percent = 100 * Count / sum(Count))
  }
  before_tab <- fmt(before) %>% rename(Before_Count = Count, Before_Pct = Percent)
  after_tab  <- fmt(after)  %>% rename(After_Count = Count, After_Pct = Percent)

  full_join(before_tab, after_tab, by = "Variant.Consequence") %>%
    mutate(across(c(Before_Count, Before_Pct, After_Count, After_Pct), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    arrange(desc(Before_Count)) %>%
    transmute(
      Consequence = Variant.Consequence,
      Before = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", format(Before_Count, big.mark = ","), Before_Pct),
      After = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", format(After_Count, big.mark = ","), After_Pct)
    )
}
```

### Variant type

```{r variant-type}
kable(variant_type_combined(data, res$step3))
```

### Consequences

```{r consequences}
kable(consequence_combined(data, res$step3))
```

## Diagnostic histograms

Depth / Alt Depth / VAF at each filtering stage (same data as the metrics above).

```{r histograms, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
metrics <- list(
  list(col = "Sample.Depth", name = "Total Depth", xlab = "Total Depth (DP)", vlines = 20, color = "steelblue"),
  list(col = "Sample.AltDepth", name = "Alt Depth", xlab = "Alt Depth (AD)", vlines = 5, color = "darkgreen"),
  list(col = "Sample.AltFrac", name = "VAF", xlab = "Variant Allele Fraction", vlines = c(0.3, 0.7), color = "purple")
)
steps <- list(
  list(data = res$step1, label = "Initial"),
  list(data = res$step2, label = "After Depth/VAF"),
  list(data = res$step3, label = "After Consequence/LoF Filtering")
)

plots <- list()
idx <- 1
for (s in steps) {
  n <- n_distinct(s$data$Sample.ID)
  for (m in metrics) {
    plots[[idx]] <- ggplot(s$data, aes(x = .data[[m$col]])) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = m$color, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = m$vlines, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      labs(title = paste0(s$label, ": ", m$name), subtitle = paste("n =", n, "individuals"),
           x = m$xlab, y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}

grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 3)
```
